units.source_text: 此时外面天色已黑，里面点着幽暗的灯火。

en.t: By this time it was already dark outside, and dim lamps were lit within.

units.source_text: 隔着帷屏，隐约可见里面情状。

en.t: Through the curtain screen, the scene inside could be faintly seen.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心念或可略见姿色，便从帷屏的隙缝间向内窥探。

en.t: Prince Genji thought he might catch a slight glimpse of their beauty, so he peered inside through a gap in the screen.

units.source_text: 但见六条妃子坐在半明半暗的灯火旁边，

en.t: He saw the Rokujo lady sitting beside the half-bright, half-shadowed lamplight,

units.source_text: 一手靠在矮几上，那剪短了的头发非常雅致。

en.t: with one hand resting on a low table, and her shortened hair looked remarkably elegant.

units.source_text: 这光景竟像一幅图画，实在美丽可爱！

en.t: The sight was like a painting, truly beautiful and lovable.

units.source_text: 并卧在寝台东边的，想必是她的女儿前斋宫了。

en.t: The one lying beside her on the east side of the bed must have been her daughter, the former Saiin.

units.source_text: 源氏公子在帷屏上拣个隙缝较大的地方，

en.t: Prince Genji chose a place in the curtain screen where the gap was somewhat wider,

units.source_text: 用心仔细张望，但见前斋宫手托香腮，容颜十分悲戚。

en.t: and looked carefully with close attention; he saw the former Saiin resting her lovely cheek in her hand, her face deeply sorrowful.

units.source_text: 虽然约略窥见，亦觉异常美丽。

en.t: Though he saw her only indistinctly, she seemed extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 那光泽的鬓发、端正的头面，以及全身姿态，都很高尚雅致。

en.t: Her glossy hair at the temples, her well-formed face and head, and her whole bearing were all noble and graceful.

units.source_text: 娇小玲珑、天真烂漫之趣，历历可观。

en.t: Her small, delicate charm and innocent freshness were plainly visible.

units.source_text: 源氏公子不禁看得神往，颇想接近她。

en.t: Prince Genji could not help gazing at her in fascination, and very much wished to draw nearer.

units.source_text: 但想起了妃子刚才的话，也就回心转意，不再妄想。

en.t: But remembering what the lady had said just before, he changed his mind and gave up such improper thoughts.

units.source_text: 六条妃子说：“哎呀，我好难过呵！

en.t: The Rokujo lady said, "Ah, I feel terribly ill.

units.source_text: 恕我失礼了，请大驾早归吧。”

en.t: Please forgive my discourtesy, and kindly return home soon."

units.source_text: 众侍女便扶她躺下了。

en.t: The attendants then helped her lie down.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“我今特地前来慰问。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "I came today especially to ask after you.

units.source_text: 贵恙若得好转，我心无限欢喜。

en.t: If your illness improves, I shall be endlessly glad.

units.source_text: 如今见此模样，教我好生担心！

en.t: Seeing you like this now makes me deeply worried.

units.source_text: 你现在好过些么？”

en.t: Are you feeling any better now?"

units.source_text: 他想探进头来看看，六条妃子便对他说：“我已衰弱得可怕了。

en.t: When he tried to lean his head in and look, the Rokujo lady said to him, "I have grown frighteningly weak.

units.source_text: 在此病势垂危之际，得蒙大驾枉顾，真乃宿缘不浅。

en.t: At this perilous stage of my illness, to receive your gracious visit must be due to a deep bond from former lives.

units.source_text: 我平生操心之事，今已约略奉告，

en.t: The matter that has troubled me all my life I have now briefly entrusted to you,

units.source_text: 若蒙鼎力照拂，我便死也瞑目了。”

en.t: and if you will kindly take it under your powerful care, I can close my eyes in death with peace."

units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“我虽无状，亦得亲聆遗言，心中实甚感激！

en.t: Prince Genji replied, "Unworthy though I am, I am truly grateful to have heard your final wishes in person.

units.source_text: 已故父皇所生皇子皇女甚多，但与我亲睦者，实无一人。

en.t: The late emperor had many princes and princesses, but in truth there is not one who is close to me.

units.source_text: 父皇视斋宫为皇女，我亦当视斋宫为妹，尽力抚养。

en.t: Since my father regarded the Saiin as a princess, I too shall regard her as my younger sister and do my utmost to care for her.

units.source_text: 况我已届为父之年龄，眼前尚无可抚养之子女，

en.t: Moreover, I have reached an age when I might be a father, yet at present I have no children to raise,

units.source_text: 生涯亦不免枯寂也。”

en.t: so my life too cannot help feeling lonely and barren."

units.source_text: 说罢，告辞退出。

en.t: After saying this, he took his leave and withdrew.
